flow_summary: The system successfully completed the intake but struggled significantly with the patient's confusion. It frequently failed to provide helpful guidance or clarification when the patient expressed difficulty, instead opting to simply repeat the exact same question, which led to a mechanical and frustrating experience for the patient.

issues.evidence: When the patient expressed confusion about the date format, the interviewer simply repeated the request: 'Please repeat your date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format.'
When the patient was confused about the email address, the interviewer simply repeated: 'Please repeat your email address.'
When the patient was confused about the phone number format, the interviewer simply repeated: 'Please repeat your 10-digit phone number.'
